_note: Content-integrity failures found 2026-09-04 and recovered 2026-09-05. These files were logged as SUCCESSFUL downloads with valid SHA-256 hashes but contained HTML error pages, not documents. Recorded here because corpus/metadata/validation_report.json now reports an empty set (the corpus is clean) and the download log predates content-validation logging. Reproduce by running the pre-fix acquisition against the legacy URLs listed.

failures.cause: legacy apps.who.int/iris bitstream path returns SPA shell after DSpace 7 migration
cdc.gov returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients
branded 404 served with HTTP 200 to non-browser clients
failures.recovery: rendered article HTML via headless browser

failures.cause: site restructured for TeamSTEPPS 3.0; PDF link only in client-rendered DOM
failures.recovery: headless browser, inline PDF captured by content-type
rendered curriculum page (standalone PDF no longer published)

impact_if_undetected: Tier 1 would have contained 14 usable documents rather than 25, with WHO, ACOG and ERAS contributing zero. A 755-byte JavaScript shell carries a valid SHA-256 and is indistinguishable from provenance in any manifest recording only HTTP status and hash.
detection_rule: magic-byte check (%PDF-) for PDFs, >=3000 extracted characters for HTML/XML, and error-page markers including the DSpace <ds-app> shell
